enabled.description: Whether the cron writes a backup of the site each day after 03:00 UTC to the R2 bucket of the deployment: the definition and the Markdown of every entry, never the images. false makes none; those already kept go when their retention passes.

retentionDays.description: How many days each daily backup is kept, 1 to 365.

automaticFields.description: The fields Hollware fills itself, so that nobody writes them: { "date": "firstPublished", "dateModified": "lastModified", "readingTime": "readingTime" }. firstPublished and lastModified fill a date field (a date written in the Markdown wins for the first, and a later one for the second); readingTime (minutes at 200 words a minute) and wordCount fill an integer. secret.description: The Worker secret that signs the deliveries. Leave it out for Hollware to make one with make_webhook_secret and keep it sealed.

url.description: The https URL that receives each event, signed.

media.description: How the site converts the images it receives (ADR-038).

format.description: What JPEG, PNG and GIF images become when they arrive: "webp", "avif", or "original" to keep them as they came. SVG is never converted.

keepOriginals.description: Whether the file as it was uploaded is kept in R2 besides the one served, for a later change of format. false keeps only the file served and its copies, which takes less storage; the images uploaded before keep theirs.

maxWidth.description: The widest an image is kept, in pixels; a wider one is scaled down, never up.

quality.description: The quality of photographs, 1 to 100. PNG images are always kept lossless.

widths.description: The widths, in pixels and smallest first, of the narrower copies made of each image when it is uploaded, for srcset: an image gets those narrower than itself. [] makes none; each copy is one more conversion of Cloudflare Images.
